purpose: Teach: 重厚/緑茶/木星/レンガ/交響楽/ブドウ/焼き鳥/安楽

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが重厚な書斎机を買ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father picked out quite a substantial desk for his study.
lines.style: Warm observational tone, sharing a small domestic detail. Gentle cadence, slightly amused at the heaviness of it. Conversational — like she's thinking out loud to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの緑茶大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love Grandma's green tea.
lines.style: Bright and direct, the way a six-year-old announces a preference without filter. Open mouth on the vowels. Quick pace, genuine. No performance — just facts he's discovered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが木星のご本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been reading a book about Jupiter lately.
lines.style: Same reflective, sharing tone as the first line. Slightly warmer this time — she notices what Dad is interested in, and she's letting Sho know. Musing quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お庭にレンガを並べてお家ごっこしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I lined up bricks in the garden and made it into a little house.
lines.style: Proud energy, though quiet about it. He's sharing an accomplishment he's genuinely pleased with. Slight lift at the end — seeking her recognition, but not desperately. Earnest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと交響楽の演奏を聴きに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should go hear an orchestra concert with your father sometime soon.
lines.style: Warm invitation, tender and including. Spoken with gentle certainty — she's thinking of something nice for both of them. Soft opening, steady through the middle, trailing with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんがブドウ狩りに連れてってくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma took me grape picking.
lines.style: Eager and bright, sharing a memory of something fun. Quick, light delivery. The joy of having done something special is still fresh. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと焼き鳥屋へ行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the yakitori place with your father one evening.
lines.style: Tender, inviting. She's weaving together the people he loves. Soft and assured — not a question, a gentle plan. Warm cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが安楽椅子で休んでらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was resting in his armchair.
lines.style: Quiet observation, the way a perceptive six-year-old notices someone at rest. Gentle, almost wondering. No urgency — just noticing Grandpa was there, being still. Soft throughout.
